title: SRCWDNet: Semantic-Relational Cross-Window Dual-Graph Network for Multi-Label Remote Sensing Scene Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.31135v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-label remote sensing scene classification remains a challenging task due to complex spatial-spectral patterns, extreme class imbalance, and inter-label dependencies that are often insufficiently modeled. To address these challenges, we introduce a Semantic-Relational Cross-Window Dual-Graph Network (SRCWDNet), which integrates three key modules: (1) a Cross-Window Attention module that captures local and global visual context through learnable global tokens; (2) a Dual Label-Graph module that adaptively combines statistical co-occurrence graphs and learned semantic-embedding graphs to facilitate label-relational reasoning; and (3) a Neural Classifier Chain that sequentially predicts labels to exploit inter-label dependencies. Evaluated using five-fold cross-validation and trained with an Asymmetric-Graph-Consistency loss, SRCWDNet achieves accuracies of 98.93% and 96.53%, with corresponding F1-scores of 0.9365 and 0.8723 on the M

translated_title: SRCWDNet：用于多标签遥感场景分类的语义关系跨窗口双图网络
translated_abstract: 多标签遥感场景分类由于复杂的空间-光谱模式、极端的类别不平衡以及往往未被充分建模的标签间依赖关系，仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种语义关系跨窗口双图网络，该网络集成了三个关键模块：（1）跨窗口注意力模块，通过可学习的全局标记捕获局部与全局视觉上下文；（2）双标签图模块，自适应地结合统计共现图与学习得到的语义嵌入图，以促进标签关系推理；（3）神经分类器链，通过顺序预测标签来利用标签间依赖关系。SRCWDNet采用五折交叉验证进行评估，并使用非对称图一致性损失进行训练，在 M（摘要在此处被截断）上分别取得了 98.93% 和 96.53% 的准确率，对应的 F1 分数分别为 0.9365 和 0.8723。
tldr: SRCWDNet通过跨窗口注意力、自适应双标签图和神经分类器链三个模块充分建模视觉上下文与标签间依赖关系，在多标签遥感场景分类任务上取得了98.93%和96.53%的高准确率。
en_tdlr: SRCWDNet integrates cross-window attention, an adaptive dual label-graph, and a neural classifier chain to fully model visual context and inter-label dependencies, achieving high accuracies of 98.93% and 96.53% in multi-label remote sensing scene classification.
